notes: UX-01 Batch 4A - UI polish only, no logic/route/state/loader/backend change. The personal-experience nav ('Bảng điểm hiện tại' + 'Hồ sơ đánh giá', for learner and manager-without-grant) previously reused .phfck-people-scope-chips - the small pill-filter style built for the Nhân sự page's 'Tất cả nhân sự/Phiếu thẩm định' toggle - which read as a secondary filter, not two peer functional areas. Replaced with a dedicated, isolated .phfck-personal-nav/.phfck-personal-layout (icon+title+description items mirroring managerSidebarHtml's visual language without reusing its literal .phfck-nav class, so no other module's sidebar is affected): a compact left-column menu on desktop that becomes a horizontal 2-item row on mobile via CSS only (both items always rendered, no JS/isMobileWorkspace branch hiding either). Renamed 'Checklist của tôi' to 'Bảng điểm hiện tại' everywhere it appeared (title(), mobileContentHeaderTitle(), nav label, page heading) - zero occurrences of the old string remain, now enforced by a regression check. Removed the near-empty full-width 'Kỳ xem' toolbar card; the period <input type=month> (same attribute, same change handler, unchanged behavior) and the manager target picker now render inline in the identity card's header. Added a compact icon empty state (own .phfck-assessment-profile-empty class, not the shared .phfck-permission-empty used elsewhere) for the Điểm kỳ hiện tại not_started/none states. Tightened card/grid spacing and added word-break safety for long chức danh/phòng ban values. Own QA pass caught and fixed a real risk: .phfck-role-main's base rule (width:min(1420px,...);margin:0 auto, meant for a standalone self-centering page) was still active inside the new flex row and would conflict with flex:1 - explicitly reset (width:auto;max-width:none;margin:0), mirroring the exact same fix .phfck-manager-layout>.phfck-role-main already applies for the manager workspace. Manager-WITH-grant pipeline (managerSidebarHtml/.phfck-manager-layout) is untouched - still the very first branch in roleWorkspaceContentHtml(), verified byte-identical by regression. Regression: scripts/test-checklist-assessment-profile-ui.js extended with CSS-isolation checks (confirms Batch 4A added no new .phfck-nav/.phfck-people-scope-chips occurrences beyond their pre-existing counts) and markup/behavior checks for the new nav, merged period control, and empty state - 88 checks total. Full checklist suite (15 scripts, including 33/33 Batch1/2 backend) re-run clean.
